Validate inputs at API/system boundaries before expensive processing; report all validation errors together when practical.
Use specific, appropriate exception types rather than generic Exception; add context where needed.

Chain exceptions to maintain the full error trail for debugging.
Preserve the original exception when re-raising to maintain the debug trail.
